_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Paths may be local (/srv/..., ~/...) or remote rsync paths (user@your-server:/path). Remote paths use your own SSH setup (key in ~/.ssh, host alias in ~/.ssh/config); no password or key goes in this file.

host.name: Your Host
host.tagline_zh: AI 主播 · 直播回放原片
host.bottom_line: 她记得来过的人，自己决定说什么。

source._lives: folder with one sub-folder per show: <id>/replay.mp4 (or detail.json with replayUrl) + detail.json + done.json
source._journal: optional: folder of the show journal, one JSON-lines file per UTC day; null if each show folder already has show.jsonl
source._notes: optional: the host's inner-notes log(s), JSON lines {"at", "note"}; [] for none

picker._mode: llm (any Anthropic Messages API compatible endpoint) or heuristic (no API: stretches where she answered viewers by name)

upload._comment: off by default. When on, the 16:9 clips of every show cut in the last max_age_hours go to <dest>/<MMDD>/<MMDD>-<NN>.mp4 with offer.json
